disease_info.message:
Conditions Dr. Deepti commonly treats:

- Nose & sinus: congestion, sinusitis, allergies, endoscopic sinus surgery
- Ear: hearing loss, infections, ear pain, microscopic ear surgery
- Vertigo: dizziness & balance disorders
- Throat & voice: swallowing difficulty, voice changes, microlaryngeal surgery
- Head & neck: screening for early warning signs

More info on Dr. Deepti's profile: https://drdeeptientdelhi.in/doctors/1
